_comment: This file declares which certification regimes THIS package is
licensed to use. The engine reads it at build time and the regime
Editions are produced by the packaging script (scripts/make_edition.py,
added post-wave-12.4) which sets `regimes` here AND strips the data/
template files for excluded regimes so they are physically absent.
full     — all regimes (CIVIL, MILITARY_DOD, SPACE). Internal/dev.
civil    — CIVIL only. The FAA/EASA customer edition.
(space editions TBD when SPACE is implemented)
IMPORTANT: this manifest is a declaration, not the enforcement. Real
protection in Model A comes from the excluded regimes' data/template
files being ABSENT from the package, not merely from this list. A
regime listed here but missing its data files degrades to unavailable;
a regime present on disk but not listed here is refused by the engine.
Both conditions must hold for a regime to be usable.
